report_findings.quantity: Producer packet C_t receives every original U_int demand exactly once; B-decrease/nontrivial-KEEP budgets counted once and cyclic capacity endpoints cancel. A valid global law with loadL would give U_int<=(2alphaL+2beta+gamma)A.

report_findings.status: Universal exact accounting reduction, explicitly not new quantitative closure
report_findings.quantity: U_int=H+E; occupied first-hit cohorts H<=K_B<=A. Thus E<=U_int<=A+E; U_int=O(A) iff E=O(A), coefficient increases by at most1.
report_findings.verification: Independently checked first-hit existence from outside-access rigidity/complete closure, and cost-one witnesses from disjoint cyclic KEEP gaps.

report_findings.status: Genuine scoped source-uniform cost theorem
report_findings.quantity: E=E_ctl+R. E_ctl counts original adjacent cohort pairs with at least one output A-acquired during its own birth-to-first-hit history. Fixed acquisition/loss endpoint selector is globally injective into original real A rotations, so E_ctl<=R_A<=2A.
report_findings.complement: R consists of original adjacent nested outputs, both A-unacquired, sharing their actual first hit. H_pq realizes arbitrarily long chains.

report_findings.status: Genuinely enlarged scoped source-uniform cost theorem
report_findings.quantity: R=R_sep+R_rem. A common B label strictly between the two outputs forces a real positive A SET loss; active-gap uniqueness makes the selector globally injective. R_sep<=P_A<=R_A<=2A. Its image is disjoint from D1 endpoint images.
report_findings.complement: R_rem: both output endpoints and every intervening B label remain A-absent through their shared lifetime. A shared outside cover can still serve many such gaps.

report_findings.status: Partial universal blind-gap reduction; no full residual bound
report_findings.quantity: D1/D2 disjoint images give E_ctl+R_sep<=R_A, hence Q_B<=9A+R_rem. Each blind-gap initial path has a first changed real B bit, with at most2 original gaps per bit. The decreasing-beta class R_dec<=2D_B<=4A is paid.
report_findings.complement: R_neu: blind gaps whose first modification is neutral. Whole-source W5 refutes an intervening-A-operation requirement for every recreated blind-gap edge.

report_findings.status: Partial universal renewal theorem; non-singleton branch class remains
report_findings.quantity: Mixed/outside-U cases are paid through existing signed inventories. Singleton-receiver subclass T<=3A, with incoming double incidence<=3. Explicit common budget F_old+R_dec+R_mix+R_out+T<=8R_A+6K_B+3H_single<=25A; therefore U_int<=26A+R_branch and Q_B<=32A+R_branch.
report_findings.correction: D_B=B1+2B2 without terminal Z1 is false. Correct identity includes Z1. Complete H_(6,1) refutes universal shrinking/output containment of a relay.
report_findings.verification: Checked combined coefficient25 and subsequent26/32 from the explicitly bounded common inventory; source family bit claims were not replayed.

report_findings.status: Substantive scoped scan payment; same-agent symbolic with classical sequential-access dependency
report_findings.quantity: R_branch=R_scan+R_irr. Long extreme-anchored consecutive S-rank windows satisfy R_scan<=6C_seq A. Internal original KEEP gaps of all such windows are disjoint. Integral source-event load<=Lambda=6ceil(C_seq). Q_B<=(32+6C_seq)A+R_irr, or coarser32+Lambda.
report_findings.complement: R_irr escapes all qualified long scans. The complete65-key G source proves strict noncoverage. No complete ratio divergence is claimed.
report_findings.verification: Checked physical ancestor-closed S applicability, the threshold n<=2(ell-1), three-gap incidence composition, and disjoint internal-gap sum. Classical sequential-access proof not reverified here.

report_findings.status: Substantive enlarged fixed-domain scan payment; same qualifications as D5
report_findings.quantity: R_irr=R_fringe+R6. For one fixed source-defined I(W), ancestor-closed physical path-isolated I windows give R_fringe<=6C_seq A, load<=Lambda globally. D5 and D6 maps may reuse the same original A units; coefficients are added. Q_B<=(32+12C_seq)A+R6.
report_findings.complement: R6 fails that independently source-defined fixed-domain eligibility. It includes a genuine gap in the complete G control. No summation over arbitrarily many adaptive I domains is licensed.
report_findings.verification: Checked path-isolation argument and global same-I internal-gap disjointness. Multi-domain coverage remains unproved.

report_findings.status: STRUCTURAL ONLY; no universal transfer
report_findings.quantity: CD5/CD6 cover complete periods with at most6 genuine KEEP target keys, arbitrary ambient trees/helpers. Disjoint separately certified closed blocks inherit coefficient2. For a fixed support sizer, the trivial core bound gives Q_B<=(r-1)A, not a uniform result.

routes.localization: No deficit-preserving reduction from an arbitrary positive deficit to a certified<=6-support complete source. Bare existence is essentially sharpCD.
routes.composition: No cover with both Q domination and bounded total original A replication. Arbitrary small-support fragments may have no same-state<=6-support return.
routes.amortization: Finite restricted-support potentials exist, but even singleton-support full-graph range is unbounded. A globally paid switching/entry law is missing.

report_findings.obstruction: Initially absent/persistently absent tickets have no uniform total multiplicity bound to earlier wing-losing A rotations or other original preparation/restoration. G_p can put many genuine R6 histories at one cheap current hit.

report_findings.status: Source-wide size-dependent ceiling, conditional on cited primary2026 near-optimality theorem
report_findings.quantity: g(n)=log2log2(max(16,n))*(1+log2log2log2(max(16,n)))^2. For every original source, 2Q_B+Z_B+K_B<=C0*g(|X|)*(2A-V_A+K_B), hence Q_B<=(3/2)C0*g(|X|)A.
report_findings.method: Extract nontrivial B targets; simulate with actual A rotations and unit service cost, bounded by R_A+K_B<=3A. Apply external theorem once to the entire repeated complete source; divide by repetitions to remove fixed initialization. The growing g(n) factor remains.
report_findings.limit: No replacement |X|→|S| is justified without a separate paid A-comparator projection. This is not DO or a constant residual payment.

report_findings.status: Valid local short-scan theorem and exact decomposition; global summability BLOCKED
report_findings.quantity: Q_B^long<=2C_seq A. Exact irregular fragments have sum ell<=A and Q_B(omega)<=C_seq*ell_omega+B(omega), where B=d_first/2+C_seq*f_terminal_side. Therefore Q_B<=3C_seq A+F_B, F_B=sum B.
report_findings.equivalence: F_B<=(1+2C_seq)Q_B^irregular+(C_seq+1/2)A, so finite-coefficient F_B/A and Q_B^irregular/A boundedness are equivalent. Substituting its own bound has coefficient>=1+2C_seq, never a contraction.
report_findings.obstruction: Original B frontier incidences do not yield bounded-load original A work; first incoming path alone is refuted.

report_findings.status: Analytic bootstrap and exact auxiliary construction proved; physical strict gain OPEN
report_findings.quantity: If F(n)<=a+theta F(n^d), theta<1, and F(n)<=K*g(n), then F(n)<=a/(1-theta), since theta^k*g(n^(d^k))→0. Exact recurrent erasure auxiliaries have unchanged physical population and weighted A cost exactlyA.
report_findings.first_missing: Source-valid frontier domination T(W)<=aA+beta sum lambda_i T(W_i) with effective beta*kappa<1. Actual construction has kappa1, but beta<1 is not established. Copying/reweighting cannot manufacture the effective discount.
report_findings.limit: For unchanged-universe auxiliaries a strict contraction plus finite F(n) already gives the bound algebraically; writing that inequality does not demonstrate easier mathematics. For polynomial enlargement the slow ceiling makes any fixedtheta<1 sufficient.

report_findings.quantity: Canonical singleton potential Phi_{x}=(q_B(x)-2p_x(A))_+, p_x=ceil(depth_A(x)/2). For all original cyclic KEEP gaps, S_gap=sum(q_i-2p_i)_+=Q_B-G, 0<=G=sum min(q_i,2p_i)<=2A; total canonical slack=2A-G<=2A. Singleton DELETE-only changes total<=2A_DELETE.
report_findings.first_missing: S_gap(W)<=c_E A(W)+(1-epsilon)*(1/r)*sum_z R6(V_z)/L_z, with absolute c_E andepsilon>0 and genuine recomputed auxiliaries. No physical domination with strict gain is proved or refuted.
report_findings.conditional_consequence: A valid one-step theorem plus the slow finite-population ceiling yields a universal coefficient(2+c)/(1-theta); the directQ inequality makes adding the oldD6 coefficient unnecessary.
report_findings.limit: S_gap differs from totalQ by at most2A. Its exact formulas resolve slack, but neither pay a new R6 subclass nor solve the global cost burden. Arbitrary feasible inflated potentials have a targeted counterexample; canonical potentials remain open.
report_findings.verification: Checked root-depth necessity from real-rotation depth change, exact singleton maximization, gap algebra, paid DELETE-Lipschitz estimate and finite-depth remainder limit. No source-engine experiment or external theorem verification.

strongest_complete_global_inequality_fro.without_new_external_benchmark: Inherited original reduction U_int<=Q_B<=6A+U_int. With D1–D6 scoped payments, Q_B<=(32+12C_seq)A+R6, retaining the exact literal residual and symbolic/classical theorem qualifications.
strongest_complete_global_inequality_fro.size_dependent_external: If the cited2026 Chmel theorem holds in the audited model, Q_B<=(3/2)C0*g(|X|)A globally. Full repetition removes additive initialization but not g(|X|).
strongest_complete_global_inequality_fro.unrestricted_constant: No report proves an absolute coefficient for all support sizes, and no complete source family refutes existence of one.

first_genuinely_missing_implication.physical_form: Repeated nested/recreated neutral B ancestry and its eventual consumers require sufficiently much ORIGINAL A preparation/restoration, or original signed decrease compensation, with an absolute TOTAL reuse bound across all cohorts, windows, roots and the cyclic seam.
first_genuinely_missing_implication.discounted_form: Alternatively a genuine auxiliary construction must dominate original unpaid cost with strict effective gain beta*kappa<1. Correct auxiliary closure, cost normalization, bounded local target count and a near-optimal ceiling do not prove that source inequality.
first_genuinely_missing_implication.not_missing: The remaining step is not finite-state existence, a first-hit witness, a raw count of births, canonical slack, the analytic contraction limit, or another tested coverage percentage.

comparison_to_current_UF_route.carry_forward: All old refutations remain constraints on new source-derived eligibility. Shared first hits, recreation without intervening A work, persistent blockers, failed low-load endpoint graphs, signed ownership and exact paired closure must remain explicit.
comparison_to_current_UF_route.do_not_mix: Old U_int/R_branch/R6/F_B/S_gap and later UF S_PF/S_PM/R_P are different literal quantities. Do not replace one by another or sum their coefficients without a proved containment/ordered partition and overlap audit.
comparison_to_current_UF_route.historical_families: A family supporting a newer periodic certificate is not an escaping UF source merely because it refuted an older charging rule. W/H/G source validity and full costs are preserved, but finite/family success does not establish general coverage.
comparison_to_current_UF_route.shortcut_verdict: No Internal Doubles/CD6 shortcut supplies the missing universal source-work law. These branches explain why local injectivity/exhaustive pointwise coverage is unnecessarily restrictive, while aggregate bounded-load conservation remains a viable open target.

route_recommendation.main: Relaxed Universal Coarse Double via one global aggregate residual inequality, using the existing paid physical mechanisms and preserving their exact original-ID interfaces.
route_recommendation.alternative: A source-valid strict discounted comparison is a mathematically sufficient alternative to paying every consumer individually. BB01/BB02 already finish its terminal analysis, so future work must produce a concrete physical strict gain, not re-prove the bootstrap algebra.
avoid: Do not restart the old exact synchronous repayment/integrability ledger as a prerequisite for an independent scalar proof.
Do not confuse adding CD(7),CD(8),... one at a time with a support-uniform theorem.
Do not relabel U_int, E, R6, F_B or S_gap as a new solved obstruction; their finite-coefficient boundedness is quantitatively tied to the original burden.
Do not infer a new A credit from a virtual zig companion, a B birth, a released owner, a second source copy, or normalization of weights.
route_recommendation.uncertainty: No source-grounded argument establishes which remaining deep universal inequality is intrinsically easiest. The recommendation is based on reusable proved interfaces and fewer additional bookkeeping requirements, not a claim that DO is close.
